revision_reason: The full eligible v2 design has 1,068,501 unordered pairs and violates its 300,000 pair hard resource cap before any primary statistic or p-value was calculated. Preserve v2's BLOCKED record and define a separate, executable, pre-outcome cohort.

canonical_core.dependency: PR #25 must be merged without source-byte changes before v3 execution; code checks git-blob identities and fails closed on drift.

cohort.eligibility: Use every one of the 64,687 source rows to form conductor groups. An eligible conductor has ≥2 distinct isogeny labels, >=1 within-label pair, >=1 between-label pair, and at least one rank block containing >=2 distinct isogeny labels.
cohort.subsample: Sort eligible conductors ascending numerically, retain zero-based indices i such that i mod 16 = 0 (starting with index 0); retain EVERY curve in each retained conductor. No other filtering or imputation.
cohort.interpretation: systematic fixed-conductor-stratum subsample, not representative/randomly sampled claims. Selection based only on prespecified inclusion criteria and N ordering.

invariants: Exact general five-integer Weierstrass invariant formulas, independent cubic discriminant and c4^3-c6^2 check inherited from immutable v2 code. External Sage/eclib agreement remains required for independent replication.

primary.statistic: equal-conductor-weighted mean of between-minus-within Euclidean arithmetic distances for ACSC minus the same contrast for modified-MCJ
primary.null: 1999 Fisher-Yates shuffles of isogeny labels within exact (conductor,rank) blocks; features, block sizes, null draws and label multiplicity preserved

sensitivity.method: one-variable-at-a-time; all shown, no favorable re-selection

resource_policy: Source/eligible/selected row and pair counts checked before primary; if any source or size mismatch, or >300,000 selected pairs, FAIL the experiment without changing stride or cap; a new version would be required.
nonclaims: No observational galaxy or cosmic study, no ACSC physics, no BSD/ECC/GLMPCT validation, no theorem, no confirmatory preregistration.
Earlier v2 never generated inference; SBX-0004 used a post-hoc rank-controlled null and is historical exploration.
A small arithmetic p-value has no physical interpretation by itself.
